skills.name: Quick Wits
skills.current_description: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
skills.proposal: Choose between a surface painter, displacement card and payoff in the current hand. Retain discard/draw and its once-per-combat limit; it grants no free board action.

skills.name: Measured Breath
skills.current_description: End your turn with an unused @icon(card_play) to bank it for your next turn. One banked @icon(card_play) maximum.
skills.proposal: Bank a play while waiting for enemy entry/start to activate prepared Ice or Fire. Banking does not advance a hazard or activate newly placed Ice by itself.

skills.name: Ghost Stride
skills.current_description: Once per combat, arm so your next movement becomes @icon(blink) 2.
skills.proposal: Use the armed Blink to cross Fire or Rubble and change attack angles. Intermediate tiles are ignored; arrival on Fire, Ice or a trap resolves normally. It is an escape tool, not landing immunity.

skills.name: Discerning Eye
skills.current_description: Once between bosses, replace every card in a combat reward.
skills.proposal: Reroll a reward when the deck needs a painter, positioning tool or payoff. Review offer coverage under the new full card pool; do not require a rare card for basic elemental function.

skills.name: Rehearsed Escape
skills.current_description: Once per combat, arm so your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card goes to discard.
skills.proposal: Reuse an Exhaust setup or payoff card later through discard. Preserve the internal preserve_burn effect meaning Exhaust; do not delete this skill with damaging Burn.

skills.name: Makeshift Tool
skills.current_description: Once per combat, arm so your next played item goes to discard instead of @icon(consume).
skills.proposal: Keep a terrain or movement item available for a later draw. The preserved item still resolves its actual printed action and pays its normal play/Time costs.

skills.name: Carry the Guard
skills.current_description: Once per combat, while you have @icon(block), arm during your turn to convert all remaining @icon(block) at turn end into @icon(stoneskin).
skills.proposal: Convert remaining Block to Stoneskin at turn end, allowing defense against next-start Fire after Block expires. No damage reduction is added to the tile itself and shared hazards remain dangerous.

skills.name: Pain Remembers
skills.current_description: After you first lose @icon(health) each combat, the next non-item card discarded while your hand has room returns to it.
skills.proposal: Actual Fire or trap health loss may prime its existing once-per-combat card recall. Fully absorbed damage does not. Repeated hazard steps never replenish the use or generate additional recalls.

skills.name: Sure-Footed
skills.current_description: Once per combat, the first @icon(traps) blast that would affect you leaves you untouched and resolves normally against everything else.
skills.disposition: rework trigger contract and rules text
skills.proposal: Ignore the first trap center hit or Air-trap outward push that would affect you, once per combat. The trap still resolves its other effects and cardinal wake. Wake placement alone neither spends the protection nor is prevented; later terrain contact/start effects follow normal rules. This lets you deliberately trigger a trap to shape the board without granting ongoing hazard immunity.

skills.name: Afterimage
skills.current_description: Your first @icon(blink) each combat leaves @icon(illusion) 2 behind. You may @icon(move) through your copies; ending on one dispels it.
skills.proposal: Blink leaves the existing decoy at the origin to redirect enemy attacks and routes. A decoy is a real shared-hazard occupant: spawning on Fire/Ice counts as arrival. Do not silently make copies immune or trigger this skill again when a surface destroys one.

skills.name: Deferred Choice
skills.current_description: Skip a card reward to save one offered card. It replaces one card in your next reward.
skills.proposal: Carry a chosen setup or payoff card into a later offer while skipping the present reward. Preserve its card-ID remap through renamed/reworked content.

skills.name: Salvager
skills.current_description: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.
skills.proposal: Recover the existing eligible missed equipment after victory. Reauthored equipment grants must match the recovered item; surface damage has already stopped before the reward flow.

skills.name: Borrowed Time
skills.current_description: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).
skills.proposal: Use a banked play for a prepared combo without adding Time on that one card. It is not a new play refund, and surface events do not independently consume or retrigger the skill.

skills.name: Last Reserve
skills.current_description: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.
skills.proposal: Keep the lethal-Fatigue safety net. Fire, trap or enemy damage is not Fatigue and does not gain this protection.

skills.name: Plunderer's Step
skills.current_description: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) to collect loot each combat refunds its @icon(card_play).
skills.proposal: Reward an actual Move/Blink that collects loot, once per combat. Use real movement and landing results, including Rubble cost and hazard deaths; blocked movement and surface creation are not loot collection.

skills.name: Prismatic Instinct
skills.current_description: Once per combat, name a card with an @icon(elemental_intensity) condition in hand. The next printed play of any copy satisfies all such conditions.
skills.proposal: Once per combat, manually place one chosen Fire, Ice, Electrified or Rubble tile on nearby visible floor. This supplies a missing setup tile or replaces hostile elemental terrain. Fire/Chill still await entry/start; Electrified and a later paid Detonate can use the new tile immediately.

skills.name: Curator's Patience
skills.current_description: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for your next relic offer.
skills.proposal: Save a synergistic unchosen relic for the next offer. Preserve exact relic identity across renames and show its revised rules before committing the choice.

skills.name: Living Shadow
skills.current_description: Once between your turns, when @icon(illusion) is destroyed or dispelled, return your most recently discarded non-item card to hand—or put it atop your draw pile if your hand is full.
skills.proposal: A decoy destroyed by a surface or dispelled still qualifies for the existing one-recall window. Sacrificing a decoy can recover a needed card, but one removal emits one event and cannot refresh the window or reproduce the decoy.

skills.name: True Bearing
skills.current_description: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.
skills.proposal: Choose an open legal starting tile using the existing range. Show starting surfaces, visible threats and arrival effects before selection. Starting on a hazard is arrival under the common contract; the room generator must retain a safe legal starting option.

skills.name: Layaway
skills.current_description: Once between bosses, hold one ware for the next Scavenger visit. A pending hold blocks future uses until it returns.
skills.proposal: Keep the retired definition out of the active skill tree. Preserve the explicit legacy-save disposition; this refactor does not reactivate the merchant reservation mechanic.

skills.name: Encore
skills.current_description: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
skills.proposal: Recover a discarded painter, displacement tool or payoff at the right moment. The recovered card still needs a normal play and real board conditions; the recall itself is not a surface or attack event.

skills.name: Open Arsenal
skills.current_description: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot, ignoring its normal slot.
skills.proposal: Use the additional equipment slot to combine different surface, mobility and defense packages. Rebudget all granted cards together, including shared grants, without adding an elemental restriction.

skills.name: Confluence
skills.current_description: @icon(elemental_intensity) conditions use your highest value, regardless of element. @icon(draw) enabled solely by Confluence stops before it would trigger @icon(fatigue).
skills.proposal: Change to a manual terrain manipulation: once per combat, relocate a chosen visible surface layer to a nearby visible floor tile. Clear only that layer at the origin and use ordinary replacement at the destination. This can remove hostile setup, relocate an Electrified relay, or combine Fire/Ice with Rubble. It cannot copy terrain, move the occupant, instantly activate Chill, or waive consumption. Keep the single-tile action as the initial rules prototype; its keystone budget requires explicit comparison with the other keystones.

skills.name: Last Door
skills.current_description: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1. Spent items stay spent.
skills.proposal: Recognize defeat from shared hazards through the same encounter outcome path as attacks. Resolve the complete simultaneous damage event before recovery; no duplicate victory reward or rollback of already-spent items.

skills.name: Long Dawn
skills.current_description: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision), and @icon(truesight) you create last @icon(time) +1. Permanent and tethered effects are unchanged.
skills.proposal: Extend only the existing timed radiance effects. Persistent surfaces have no duration and gain neither extra lifetime nor immediate occupant activation from this skill.

skills.name: Sunpath
skills.current_description: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ each turn leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 on every tile entered. @icon(blink) also covers its origin and destination.
skills.proposal: Leave Light along the resolved qualifying movement route, preserving its distinct visibility role. Rubble spending extra movement points must not count as extra distance traveled. Blink lights its existing origin/destination pattern, not crossed hazard tiles.

skills.name: Witchlight
skills.current_description: Each living @icon(illusion) adds +1 to its tethered @icon(illuminate).
skills.proposal: Decoys reveal useful routes and terrain through their tethered Light. Remove that tether when the decoy dies, including to a hazard. Fire/Electrified visual glow never independently reveals hidden actors.

skills.name: Dawnbrand
skills.current_description: The first direct attack each turn against an enemy in @icon(illuminate) inflicts @icon(expose) 1.
skills.proposal: Keep the first direct attack against an enemy in Light applying Expose. Classify newly authored direct attacks such as Detonate explicitly; passive Fire, surface placement and empty Chain relay visits do not qualify. Use one action-scoped trigger with deterministic actual recipient, not one proc per tile.

skills.name: Afterglow
skills.current_description: When @icon(illusion) is removed during combat, it leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at its final tile.
skills.proposal: Leave the existing temporary Light at a decoy removal caused by hazard, attack or dispel. Emit it once from the real final tile, without clearing or copying underlying terrain.

skills.name: Open Sky
skills.current_description: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).
skills.proposal: Keep Truesight while standing in actual Light. Neither glowing surfaces nor terrain knowledge substitutes for Light or grants knowledge of unseen Chain targets.
